excerpt.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
excerpt.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

texts.zh:
通过对在[From.GetName]星系的未识别舰队的身份码的调查，我们得到了意料之外的发现。舰队实际上并不位于黑洞的安全轨道，而是跨过了事件视界。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测舰队在数世纪之前就抵达了[From.GetName]的事件视界，在这里时间膨胀使得舰队在黑洞表面留下了它们的影像。

舰队是有意采取了这样的行动，还是遭受了不幸了事故，我们可能永远无从知晓。它们的身份识别码与所有已知文明都无法匹配。
texts.en:
Investigation of the unrecognized fleet signatures in the [From.GetName] system revealed an unexpected discovery. The fleet is not, in fact, in safe orbit of the black hole, but rather crossing its event horizon.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] conjectures that the fleet approached [From.GetName]'s event horizon centuries ago, whereupon time dilation left their image detectable on its surface.

Whether the fleet's actions were intentional, or the result of some unhappy accident, we may never know. Their signatures match no known civilization on record.
